name: room
text: Room opened — goal: visual: Mine AI website/product DESIGNS (the look), taste-learn from Eitan's picks.

name: Easel
text: As we start designing the look of the Mine AI website and product, I think we should prioritize a clean and minimalist aesthetic. This approach will allow us to create a visually appealing and user-friendly interface that lets the AI capabilities shine, and it's also in line with Eitan's design preferences. By going minimalist, we're accepting the trade-off of potentially limiting our ability to add too many flashy features or complex graphics, but I believe this simplicity will ultimately enhance the overall user experience. This decision will also give us a solid foundation to build upon and make future design updates more efficient.

name: Squint
text: Squint (skeptic): A clean and minimalist aesthetic risks feeling *too* sterile—like a generic AI dashboard—if we don’t anchor it to Mine AI’s actual product *value*. Eitan’s picks lean toward bold, expressive contrast (think dynamic gradients or layered typography) to signal innovation, not just clarity. The tiebreaker? Mock up both approaches and test which one makes users *feel* the AI’s edge, not just see it.
